hero.h1: Faucet Repair and Installation in Skokie, IL
hero.sub: A faucet that drips all night, a shutoff valve that won't turn or a new kitchen sink to hook up. We repair and install faucets and fixtures in Skokie homes. Our office is on Lincoln Avenue.

blocks.h2: When to Call About a Faucet

tiles.body: A worn washer, seat or cartridge.

tiles.h3: The Shutoff Under the Sink Won't Turn

tiles.body: A leaking supply line or drain.

bodies: We repair and replace kitchen faucets of every style. Many older faucets in Skokie homes use washers and seats that wear out, while newer ones use cartridges.
Replacing an old faucet is often a good time to replace the shutoff valves and supply lines too.
We handle the whole kitchen: drains, shutoffs, dishwasher hookups, ice maker lines and [garbage disposals](/skokie/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Updating a postwar kitchen? We can move or add plumbing for a new layout.

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets and showerheads, and check the shutoffs and supply lines while we're there.
Replacing several fixtures? We'll schedule it so it's done in one visit when possible.

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Skokie Homes
blocks.intro: Many Skokie homes still have original plumbing behind newer fixtures.

items.body: Valves from decades ago often won't close when you need them.
Old pipe can restrict flow to a brand-new faucet.
Laundry tub faucets wear out and leak.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

steps.body: We tell you which makes sense.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: Laundry Tub and Utility Sink Faucets
blocks.body: Many Skokie basements have an old laundry tub with a faucet that drips, leaks at the base or won't shut off. These faucets get heavy use and little attention. We repair or replace them, along with the supply lines and shutoffs. If the tub itself is cracked, we can replace that too and connect it to the drain properly.

items.q: Why is my new faucet's pressure low?
items.preview: Often the old pipe feeding it.
items.answer: Often the aerator is clogged with debris loosened during install, or old galvanized pipe is restricting flow. We check both.

items.q: Should I replace the shutoff valves too?
items.answer: If they're original or hard to turn, yes. It's easiest while the faucet is being replaced.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I already bought?
items.answer: Yes, as long as it's complete and suited to your sink.

items.q: Do you repair laundry tub faucets?
items.answer: Yes. We repair or replace laundry tub faucets and the tubs themselves.

items.q: Can you replace a laundry tub?
items.answer: Yes, along with its faucet and drain.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
